description: This file defines a Mongoose schema and model for managing costs related to large language models (LLMs). It includes schema definitions for cost breakdowns and overall cost entries, with indexes designed to optimize filtering, sorting, and querying based on tenant, organization, session, model, and other attributes. Exports a mongoose model used for storing and retrieving LLM cost records in a MongoDB collection named 'llm-costs'.

classes.name: LLMCostsSchema
classes.description: Mongoose schema defining the structure and indexes for LLM cost documents, including metadata, cost breakdown, and timestamp fields.

classes.name: CostBreakdownSchema
classes.description: Sub-schema for detailed cost components, allowing arbitrary key-value pairs with permissive schema settings.

methods.name: pre('findOneAndUpdate')
methods.description: Mongoose middleware that updates the 'updated_at' timestamp before executing a findOneAndUpdate operation.
